name: i-ran-pilot
style: Realistic cinematic photography, anamorphic 35mm music-video look, moody but readable exposure: dark emerald and teal shadows, a warm orange firelight key on faces, thin green lasers in humid haze, rim light, sweat glistening, natural skin detail, correct human anatomy and natural proportions, subtle film grain, physically coherent motion.

rafa.name: Rafa
rafa.identity: Keep exactly his face, bone structure, dark eyes, thick curly black hair, thin moustache and goatee, diamond stud earrings, warm olive-tan skin (the same tone on face, arms and legs) and lean athletic build.
rafa.look: Earthy jungle-festival utility set: an unbuttoned short-sleeve camp shirt worn open over his bare chest with a black tactical nylon chest harness with grey buckles strapped over his bare torso, and matching relaxed knee-length cargo shorts with plain flat flap side pockets, both cut from the same washed olive-khaki cotton ripstop fabric; a faded grey paisley bandana knotted loosely around his neck; his thin gold chain with a small cross pendant plus a short cord necklace of dark wooden beads; stacked chunky silver chain bracelets on both wrists; and on his feet only, scuffed tan suede lace-up boots with grey socks.

lune.name: Lune
lune.identity: Keep exactly her face, features, full lips, brown eyes, freckles and long wavy chestnut-brown hair; a slim confident woman in her mid twenties with sun-warm skin.
lune.look: Earthy-futurist jungle-festival outfit: a strappy brushed-silver metallic halter harness bikini top; low-slung distressed washed-olive denim micro shorts with frayed hems; a thin beaded waist chain; stacked silver chain bracelets and a twisted barbed-wire-style silver cuff climbing her left forearm; a wide metallic silver fabric headwrap tied across her forehead with a few small yellow flowers tucked into her hair; small silver hoops; and on her feet only, short scuffed tan suede lace-up ankle boots.

canopy_floor.prompt: a packed night-time jungle rave rendered as soft out-of-focus bokeh behind the subject: blurred silhouetted dancers, glowing teal stage lights, green laser haze and warm bulb strings through palm fronds.

lagoon_edge.prompt: the dark edge of a jungle lagoon, softly defocused, orange fire reflections rippling on black water, big leaves in the near foreground, pale moonlit mist far behind.

jungle_trail.prompt: a moonlit jungle trail between giant leaves and hanging vines, silver-blue moonlight shafts through mist, softly defocused.

rope_bridge.prompt: a swaying wooden rope bridge over dark jungle lined with small torches, the glowing futuristic festival city and a huge full moon far behind, softly defocused.

cliff_top.prompt: a rocky jungle clifftop high above a moonlit lagoon, a huge full moon in drifting mist, the glowing festival city far off, softly defocused.

lagoon_underwater.prompt: deep teal water under the lagoon surface, shafts of moonlight, rising silver bubbles, floating leaves.

cliff_moon.prompt: a dark jungle cliff edge in silhouette on the right, an enormous warm amber full moon filling the night sky behind, thin mist below.

lagoon_moon.prompt: calm dark lagoon water at night, an enormous warm amber full moon low on the horizon behind, its golden reflection rippling on the water, dark jungle silhouettes at the edges.

dark_jungle.prompt: a pitch-dark night jungle of huge leaves, roots and hanging vines, lit only by distant green laser flashes and faint orange glow from the far-off rave through the trees, thin mist.

shots.summary: Now: the rave at its peak, seen through palm fronds.
shots.still: A sea of silhouetted dancers with raised hands under fanning green lasers, palm fronds framing the top of the frame.
shots.motion: Hands pump to the beat; lasers sweep left to right.
shots.camera: Slow push forward through the fronds.

alts.framing: High wide aerial angle, 20mm lens.
alts.camera: Slow drone-like glide over the crowd toward the laser stage.

alts.framing: Low wide angle from inside the crowd, 24mm lens.
alts.camera: Handheld, weaving forward between dancers' shoulders.

shots.summary: Now: Lune is lost in the song in the middle of the crowd.
shots.framing: Eye-level medium close-up from the chest up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, other ravers soft on both sides. Tight framing: the face fills the upper third of the frame.
shots.still: Lune dances hard in the middle of the crowd, eyes closed, singing along, hair flying, a warm orange firelight key on her face and teal laser spill on her shoulder.
shots.motion: She throws her head back, spins once and keeps dancing, lost in the song.
shots.camera: Fast handheld orbit around her, ravers sliding past in the foreground.

alts.framing: Profile medium close-up, 100mm lens, background melted into bokeh.
alts.camera: Handheld, bouncing with her dancing.

alts.framing: Wide shot, 24mm: she is one dancer in the heaving crowd.
alts.camera: Slow crane down into the crowd toward her.

shots.summary: Then: Lune laughs and looks back at someone chasing her through the moonlit jungle.
shots.framing: Eye-level medium close-up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
shots.still: Lune, hair swinging, turns her head to her left and breaks into a laugh, looking back over her shoulder at someone chasing her.
shots.motion: She completes the turn, laughs, and starts to run out of frame left.

alts.framing: Wide shot of her running between giant leaves, 35mm lens. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
alts.camera: Tracking alongside her at running speed.

alts.framing: Close-up of her face, 100mm lens. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
alts.camera: Handheld, bobbing with her run.

shots.summary: Then: Rafa chases after her, grinning.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 50mm lens, motion blur in the background. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
shots.still: Rafa runs toward camera through big leaves, grinning, his bandana and open shirt flying.
shots.motion: He runs toward camera and pushes a large leaf aside.
shots.camera: Low fast backward tracking shot, leaves whipping past the lens.

alts.framing: Wide shot from behind him as he runs down the trail, 35mm lens. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
alts.camera: Following behind at running speed.

alts.framing: Low angle close-up of his grin, 85mm lens. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
alts.camera: Handheld, running backward in front of him.

shots.summary: Now: Lune breaks out of the crowd and runs into the dark jungle.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 35mm lens, deep shadows.
shots.still: Lune bursts out from between the last dancers at the crowd's edge and runs into the dark jungle, breathing hard, lit by a passing green laser.
shots.motion: She sprints past camera into the darkness, glancing back once.
shots.camera: Fast handheld tracking at running speed, leaves and branches whipping past the lens.

alts.framing: Wide shot from the jungle looking back at the glowing rave, 24mm: her silhouette running out of the light toward camera.
alts.camera: Backward tracking in front of her.

alts.framing: Close-up of her face as she runs, 85mm lens, only laser flashes lighting her.
alts.camera: Handheld, running beside her.

shots.summary: Now: running along the crowd's edge, she glimpses Rafa through a gap, far away.
shots.framing: Long-lens tracking shot, 135mm, Lune soft in the foreground running along the edge of the crowd; Rafa far away across the crowd, small but recognizable.
shots.still: Lune runs along the crowd's edge and sees Rafa through a gap between dancers, far away; dancers keep crossing between them.
shots.motion: She slows for a second, reaching toward the gap, as the dancers close it again.
shots.camera: Tracking alongside her at running speed, rack focus from Lune to Rafa.

alts.framing: Reverse long-lens shot, 135mm, over Rafa's shoulder; Lune running far away across the crowd.
alts.camera: Tracking with Rafa, rack focus to Lune.

alts.framing: Wide shot, 24mm, both at opposite edges of the frame, the crowd flowing between them.
alts.camera: Fast lateral dolly as the crowd surges between them.

shots.summary: Now: Rafa runs through the crowd after her.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field.
shots.still: Rafa runs and shoves between dancers toward camera, eyes locked on something far ahead.
shots.motion: He forces his way forward, but the crowd keeps closing in front of him.
shots.camera: Fast backward tracking in front of him.

alts.framing: Over-the-shoulder from behind him, 35mm lens, the crowd a wall ahead.
alts.camera: Handheld, pushing through with him.

alts.framing: High angle wide shot, 24mm: one figure fighting against the flow of the whole crowd.
alts.camera: Slow crane down toward him.

shots.summary: Now: the crowd surges and sweeps Lune backward, away from him.
shots.framing: Medium shot, 35mm lens, the crowd pressing on all sides.
shots.still: A surge of jumping dancers floods between Lune and the camera; she reaches forward over their shoulders but is carried backward.
shots.motion: She is pulled further and further back into the crowd, her reaching hand the last thing visible.
shots.camera: Handheld, the camera itself jostled by the crowd.

alts.framing: Wide shot from above, 24mm: the crowd flowing like a current carrying her away.
alts.camera: Slow overhead drift.

alts.framing: Close-up of her reaching hand among other raised hands, 85mm lens.
alts.camera: Handheld, losing her hand among the others.

shots.summary: Then: running hand in hand across the torch-lit rope bridge.
shots.framing: Medium two-shot from behind, 35mm lens. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
shots.still: Lune pulls Rafa by the hand across a swaying rope bridge toward the glowing festival city, both laughing.
shots.motion: They run away from camera; she looks back at him.

alts.framing: Front two-shot, 50mm lens, both faces laughing. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
alts.camera: Backward tracking in front of them.

alts.framing: Wide side view of the whole bridge over the dark jungle, 35mm lens. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
alts.camera: Slow lateral dolly following them across.

shots.summary: Then: running hand in hand toward the cliff edge above the moonlit lagoon.
shots.framing: Medium-wide shot from behind, 24mm lens, deep shadows, moonlit amber backlight.
shots.still: Silhouettes of Lune and Rafa running hand in hand through a curtain of hanging jungle roots toward a glowing cliff edge, moonlight blazing through the gaps.
shots.camera: Fast low handheld tracking right behind their heels, roots whipping past the lens.

alts.framing: Front medium two-shot, 35mm lens, faces lit by the moon. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation.
alts.camera: Backward tracking in front of them.

alts.framing: Wide side profile along the cliff top, 50mm lens, the moon ahead of them.
alts.camera: Lateral tracking at their speed.

shots.summary: Then, slow motion: they leap off the cliff hand in hand across a giant full moon.
shots.framing: Wide side-profile shot, 135mm telephoto compression: a giant amber full moon fills most of the frame behind the cliff edge on the right.
shots.still: Lune and Rafa, pure black silhouettes in side profile, leap off the jungle cliff edge hand in hand, legs mid-stride, arms outstretched, crossing the face of the enormous glowing moon.
shots.motion: In graceful slow motion they sail across the moon and begin to arc downward.
shots.camera: Locked-off telephoto with a slow drift to follow the arc.

alts.framing: Low angle from below the cliff looking up, 35mm lens, the moon behind them.
alts.camera: Locked-off low angle as they fly overhead.

alts.framing: Behind them on the cliff edge, 24mm lens, the lagoon far below.
alts.camera: Following them to the edge and stopping as they leap.

shots.summary: Then: they plunge into the lagoon in an explosion of bubbles.
shots.framing: Underwater medium shot, 24mm lens, moonlight rays from the surface, teal water.
shots.still: Underwater, Lune and Rafa plunge into the dark lagoon side by side in an explosion of churning white bubbles, moonlight shafts from above.
shots.motion: In slow motion the bubbles burst around them, then they kick upward toward the light.

alts.framing: Underwater wide shot looking up at the bright surface, 20mm lens.
alts.camera: Locked-off as they crash in from above.

alts.framing: Underwater close-up of their joined hands in the bubbles, 50mm lens.
alts.camera: Slow drift as their hands slip apart.

shots.summary: Now: Rafa runs out into the black jungle, searching in the wrong direction.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 35mm lens, deep shadows.
shots.still: Rafa runs out of the rave into the pitch-dark jungle, searching, pushing through huge leaves, lit only by distant laser flashes.
shots.motion: He runs deeper into the darkness, turning to look each way, heading the wrong way.
shots.camera: Fast handheld tracking at running speed, leaves and branches whipping past the lens.

alts.framing: Wide shot, 24mm: his small silhouette running away from the glowing rave into the black jungle.
alts.camera: Locked-off as he runs away from camera.

alts.framing: Close-up of his face as he runs, 85mm lens.
alts.camera: Handheld, running backward in front of him.

shots.summary: Now: Lune runs through the dark jungle, stumbling, looking back.
shots.framing: Medium shot, 35mm lens, deep shadows, only distant laser flashes.
shots.still: Lune runs through the pitch-dark jungle, stumbling over roots, lit only by flashes of distant green lasers, looking back over her shoulder.
shots.motion: She stumbles, catches herself and keeps running, looking back into the dark.
shots.camera: Fast handheld tracking at running speed, leaves and branches whipping past the lens.

alts.framing: Wide shot from behind her, 24mm, the jungle swallowing her.
alts.camera: Following behind at running speed.

alts.framing: Low angle of her feet and legs racing over roots and leaves, 35mm lens.
alts.camera: Low fast tracking beside her feet.

shots.summary: Then, the last memory: they kiss waist-deep in the lagoon before the giant moon.
shots.framing: Medium two-shot at water level, 135mm telephoto, the giant amber full moon filling the background, its reflection rippling on the water.
shots.still: Lune and Rafa, wet hair slicked back, hold each other waist-deep in the dark water and kiss, silhouetted against the enormous glowing moon.
shots.motion: Slow motion: they pull close and kiss, water dripping, ripples spreading.
shots.camera: Slow push-in at water level, a gentle rack focus onto their faces.

alts.framing: Wide shot at water level, 50mm lens, two small silhouettes before the enormous moon.
alts.camera: Locked-off.

alts.framing: Close-up of their faces touching, 100mm lens, moonlit rim light.
alts.camera: Very slow orbit.

shots.summary: Now: Lune runs on alone into the dark, looking back in fear; he is nowhere.
shots.still: Lune runs alone deeper into the dark jungle, looking back over her shoulder in fear, the rave's glow now only a faint distant light through the trees.
shots.motion: She runs away from camera into total darkness, looking back once more.
shots.camera: Tracking behind her, slowly falling back as she outruns the camera.

alts.framing: Close-up of her face, 100mm lens, running, looking back.
alts.camera: Handheld, running backward in front of her.

alts.framing: Wide high angle, 24mm: the black jungle, one small figure running, the rave a faint glow on the horizon.
alts.camera: Slow crane up and away.

sheet.front: Character reference panel: one full-body front view, head to toe with both feet fully visible and space above the head, standing straight and relaxed, arms at the sides, facing the camera. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.back: Character reference panel: one full-body BACK view. The person faces directly away from the camera: we see the back of the head, the hair from behind, the shoulder blades, the back of the outfit, the backs of the legs and the heels. The face is not visible at all. Head to toe with both feet fully visible, arms relaxed at the sides. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.side: Character reference panel: one full-body SIDE profile view. The person is turned a strict 90 degrees to the right: only the right side of the body and one eye are visible, nose pointing to the right edge of the frame, like a passport profile. Head to toe with both feet fully visible, arms relaxed at the sides. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.anchor: Three-quarter-length fashion reference photo from the top of the head to mid-thigh, standing straight facing the camera, arms relaxed, the whole outfit clearly visible. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.closeup: Character reference panel: an extreme close-up portrait of the face and shoulders only. The head fills the upper two thirds of the frame; the crop ends at the upper chest. Facing the camera directly, neutral expression. Do not show the waist, legs or feet. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.

keyframe_rules: Use the reference images only for each person's identity and wardrobe: do not copy their pose, framing, lighting or grey background. Relight them with the scene: warm firelight on the face, teal and green laser spill on skin, sweat glistening. Natural candid mid-action body language, never posing for the camera.
extras: Background ravers are varied strangers in their own clothes (camo tanks, crop tops, fishnet, hoodies, tech visor goggles, glow bracelets); none of them wears the lead characters' outfits.
soundscape: Muffled heavy festival bass, crowd cheering, humid jungle night ambience, no dialogue.
variation_hints: Alternate take: a more dynamic camera, a faster orbit or tracking move with foreground elements sweeping past the lens.
Alternate take: slow motion, a tighter lens and a gentle rack focus, more intimate performance.
